name: board-{DAY}
title: Opportunity board {DAY}
subtitle: The plan in one tab, then every US $2B+ name in one grid with each suite's read beside it: timing and the bounce band, the earnings bar of this week's and next week's reporters, the model, value to peers and to the forward-value run, risk. Screens are reading orders; each column is its own read and nothing is a sum.

blocks.text: Every name with a priced bounce band (the buy-in-red band under the close from the safety band, levels window or named). to_band_high_pct = how far the close must fall to fill at the band top; kill_dist_pct = the distance to the bounce kill. The alpha model's 28-day band (b28d_q20 / b28d_q80, %) and deciles sit beside it. A screen is a reading order, not a buy list.

blocks.title: Timing: tape, the bounce band, the model's band

source.sql: SELECT symbol, ind, mcap_b, book_usd, close, day, w, m1, m3, rsi, rng, vs50, vs200, atrp, relvol, tape_state, trend_q, updown_vol, band_state, bounce_low, bounce_high, bounce_kill, to_band_high_pct, kill_dist_pct, first_target, sma_role, b28d_q20, b28d_q80, dec_7d, dec_28d, pred_28d, dec_56d, peer_gap_pct, earn_date, earn_days, beta, det FROM names WHERE bounce_low IS NOT NULL ORDER BY to_band_high_pct DESC NULLS LAST

screens.explain: The close is within 3% of the bounce band top (or inside it): the band is a live order today.

screens.label: Extended

screens.label: Breakout on volume

screens.label: Cheap to peers

screens.label: Book lines

blocks.text: This week's and next week's reporters in their positioning cell (terciles of the run-up into the print, the 3-month tape and the 3-month EPS estimate change on the lab's past prints). Low bar = estimates cut (bar_rev T1) and a weak tape (bar_tape T1): beats paid most there. High bar = estimates raised (T3) and a strong tape (T3): about half of beats sold. c_bar_text is the surprise the cell needed; p_beat / ev_* mix the cell with the name's own beat record (a read, never a gate). Strength beside it: the model decile, the peer gap, the up-pattern letters.

entries.group: Letters (det: deterioration; pat_up / pat_dn: winners anatomy)
rows: E
det: next-FY EPS estimate cut by more than 1% over about 3 months. pat_up: not used.
R
det: next-FY revenue estimate cut by more than 1% over about 3 months.
C
det: free cash flow margin under 0 (cash burn). pat_up: street upside in its top quintile, a print within 28 days, estimates not cut, under the 200-day.
S
det: last reported EPS under its estimate.
O
pat_up: RSI in its lowest quintile with p_fwd in its top quintile (oversold, forward set-up strong).
B
pat_up: printed within 10 days with a beat, last week in its lowest quintile (a beat that was sold).
I
pat_up: the industry's 3-month return in its lowest quintile while the industry's last surprises are in their top quintile.
D
pat_up: 1-month return in its lowest quintile with p_dvc in its top quintile (a durable compounder that fell).
H
pat_up: far from its 91-day high (hi_prox lowest quintile) with p_dvc in its top quintile.
V
pat_up: 3-month return in its lowest quintile, street upside in its top quintile, estimates not cut.
L
pat_up: 1-month return in its lowest quintile, street upside in its top quintile, a print within 28 days.
X
pat_dn: breakout score in its top quintile with weekly consensus in its lowest (a breakout nobody confirms).
Y
pat_dn: breakout score in its top quintile with p_fwd in its lowest quintile.
Z
pat_dn: 1-month return in its top quintile with p_fwd in its lowest quintile (a run without a forward read).
Lane
Why the row is on the plan: exit, park (low beta), hedge, event (an earnings ticket from the event budget), add after the events, trim.
Bar
Low bar = estimates cut and a weak 3-month tape into the print (bar_rev / bar_tape T1); high bar = both in their top third (T3); middle otherwise.
The cell says
What beats and misses did on past prints in the reporter's beat-bar cell: the day's reaction vs the market and the 28-day hold (h28), pp; n = prints in the cell.
Level
The prices that act on a Book line: bounce band, kill, resting trim.
For (data)
Conviction log: the measured reads that back the course (cell mean and t, model decile, peer gap, street, letters absent), each its own number, never summed.
Against (data)
Conviction log: the measured reads that argue against it (letters, street under the price, crowd stress, above the band, a weak cell).
What changes it
Conviction log: the price or event that raises, lowers or ends the course (a close through the kill, a print, a trigger).
Cost of staying
The line's deterioration cell (dd | letters) and its measured mean excess over 28 days vs the median name: what holding this state has paid.
Beta
Store beta against the cap-weighted US floor (panel store); negative = tends to rise when the market falls.
Catalyst (OUTSIDE)
The outside event or policy that could move the name (dated, sourced on the page's Sources tab); it changes timing or Grade only, never the order or the size.
Data
The pack's reads that keep the name on the list: model decile, IRR vs hurdle, peer gap, letters, beta.
